title: Linearized Solutions as an Affine Subspace
statement: Let $L$ be a list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over $mathbb{F}_2$, and suppose that $a_0\in\mathbb{F}_2^{n^2}$ satisfies the associated linearized system. For every $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^{n^2}$, $a$ satisfies that system if and only if it belongs to the affine subspace through $a_0$ whose direction consists of the solutions to the corresponding homogeneous linear system.
